title: AshuTeacher — AI Interactive Blackboard & Exam Solver
excerpt: Upload any PDF, screenshot, or tough topic. Watch it written step-by-step on a smart blackboard with live voice narration. Claim 30 free credits!
content_html:
Sign up in 10 seconds (no credit card needed) to unlock live voice-narrated blackboard lessons, YouTube lecture conversion, Socratic coaching, exam paper solving, quizzes & 3D flashcards across 95 Indian & world languages.

AI Voice Blackboard • Exam Paper Solver • Thesis Studio

Built for university, board, and competitive-exam students (plus thesis researchers). Watch step-by-step blackboard explanations with synchronized voice narration in 95 Indian & world languages—starting free with 30 credits and zero subscriptions.

▶ Watch Instant Free Demo (No Login):

Blackboard Classroom

Live voice-narrated lectures from topics, PDFs, images, or web URLs.

Solve Exam Paper

Upload PDFs or paste homework screenshots for step-by-step LaTeX solutions.

Course & Syllabus Builder

Generate structured multi-chapter learning paths and track mastery.

Quiz & 3D Flashcards

Practice MCQs, challenge classmates with shareable links, and drill 3D decks.

Paste any YouTube lecture URL → Voice Blackboard, Quiz & Cards in 95 languages.

Step-by-step hints & questions that teach you to solve it yourself without spoilers.

Record class live via mic → instant clean Blackboard notes, Cheat Sheet & Flashcards.

Share any quiz on WhatsApp—friends play free with zero login to beat your score.

No credit card required
